messages:
alex-finance: Acquirer submitted a consumer dispute for acct_2339 claiming duplicate billing - says they were billed twice for March invoice (one recurring + one "usage adjustment"). Bank put a temporary hold on settlement. Need evidence and quick recommendation.

maria-payments: Which txns/amounts? Ill fetch auth/capture and descriptor.

alex-finance: TX-DUP-301 ($950) and TX-ADJ-302 ($950) on 2026-03-22 14:02 and 14:05 UTC. Total $1,900. Cardholder email billing@pixelworks.io. Customer claims merchant descriptor shows "Redwood-Xfer" twice.

fraud-bot: ALERT: score=0.35 (low fraud), descriptor_mismatch=TRUE (one charge uses partner billing descriptor), account_history=ok, recommend REVIEW.

jo-cs: Customer says this is a billing error and wants immediate refund for the duplicate charge. They provided a screenshot of their bank statement showing two identical items.

maria-payments: Quick artifacts:
```
mask_pan,txn_id,amount,descriptor
**** **** **** 7777,TX-DUP-301,950,Redwood-Xfer
**** **** **** 7777,TX-ADJ-302,950,Partner: AcmeRelay
```
I uploaded receipts/invoices and payment chain: https://internal-s3/redwood/chargebacks/1910007777/bundle.zip (restricted). Bundle includes invoices, receipts, proto-descriptor-mapping.csv, and payment_gateway_logs.txt (redacted).

ops-bot: Note: pricing experiment EXP-23 rolled out last week that auto-applies a partner relayer charge for selected accounts (opt-out). acct_2339 was in the cohort. Tagging product ops.

alex-finance: Ah — that explains the partner descriptor on the second line. But the customer says they didnt opt in/werent notified clearly. Need to provide timeline of consent + invoice showing itemized charges.

ravi-legal: Before sending to issuer: redact PAN, include itemized invoices showing both charges, copy of served billing notice for EXP-23, consent logs (email or UI), and any click-through timestamp. Also include gateway AVS/CVV pass/fail info. Do not include full CVV.

jo-cs: I found a support note where product emailed cohort on 2026-03-15 with subject "Experiment: partner routing for lower latency" and the account did not reply. Email was sent to ops@pixelworks.io.

maria-payments: Evidence bundle updated with: itemized_invoice_2339.pdf, experiment_notification.eml (redacted), consent_log.csv, gateway_response.json (redacted). Re-uploaded link: https://internal-s3/redwood/chargebacks/1910007777/bundle_v2.zip

fraud-bot: Supplemental: AVS matched, CVV not stored, gateway captured auth with auth_code=GZ123. No other fraud flags.

alex-finance: Recommendation: 1) Submit evidence to issuer showing both charges were authorized and that experiment notification was sent. 2) Offer immediate one-time courtesy refund of $950 only if customer agrees to pause dispute and sign an acknowledgment about the experiment messaging. 3) If customer refuses, contest and let representment proceed. Approve?

ravi-legal: Approve evidence submit. On the courtesy refund: OK if CS secures written pause of dispute and explicit acceptance; document retention required.

jo-cs: Reached out to customer offering either full contest or a $950 goodwill credit if they confirm in writing theyll pause dispute. Waiting on reply.

maria-payments: Ill queue representment with the redacted bundle now as a precaution and mark as "merchant has offered resolution". If customer accepts credit, we can retract before final representment outcome per acquirer rules.

ops-bot: Product owner noted — will review notification language for EXP-23 and update billing UI by next cadence.

alex-finance: Thanks everyone. Please post customer reply here and tag me. Target: evidence submitted before 18:00 UTC.

fraud-bot: Case CB-2026-2339 logged."
